movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Attacker holds the stick in front of their face during the approach.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two players in a playing field; can be a circle in the Baluchi variant.
movement_profile.partnering: Attack and defense interaction between two players.

signature_moves.description: A skillful player who rotates the playing field for several rounds without fatigue.
signature_moves.name: Shirin kar

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not strike the opponent; only swing the bat and threaten.

music_profile.sound_description: Traditional tochmal music featuring the percussive dohol drum and the melodic karnay horn.
music_profile.vocal_style: Attacker screams loudly to undermine opponent's morale.

basic_steps: Dance laps around the playing area before engaging.
Attacker swings the short stick while yelling.
Defender uses the long stick to block the strike to the legs.
Players switch sticks and roles after each attack.
teaching.formation: Two players face-to-face or a circle formation in the Baluchi variant.
teaching.level_notes: Reserved for experienced players due to the speed and intensity of the Lori variant.
teaching.rhythm: Follows the rhythm of the dohol drum.
